title: GET MANIFE$TO
author: Matt Bee
description:
You came to the Vividyne Energy Research Compound seeking answers, but what started as an investigation soon becomes a struggle to escape with your life. What's the government so desperate to cover up? Can the lizard man be trusted? And what exactly was the mysterious Blunzing Incident? Find out in GET MANIFE$TO, a thrilling text-and-type adventure for all Glulx-compatible home computers. Out now!

Content warning: this game contains comic violence, spooky skeletons, some vulgar language and the use of fictional psychoactive substances. It has been voluntarily rated PC-13 (pretty crass.)
